2609.09076.title: ActReview: Rebuttal-Guided Training Data and Rubric Rewards for Actionable Peer Review Generation
2609.09076.paper_summary: As LLMs are increasingly used for pre-submission self-review, there is growing demand for feedback that not only identifies weaknesses but also guides authors toward concrete revisions. We study this as Actionable Peer-review Generation and decompose it into two subtasks: diagnostic claim generation and revision suggestion generation. We introduce ActReview, a rebuttal-guided post-training framework that connects paper-specific diagnoses to concrete, grounded revision plans. Our central insight is that author rebuttals reveal plausible actions for addressing reviewer concerns and can therefore provide latent supervision for revision-oriented feedback. From real review-rebuttal threads on OpenReview, we construct ActReview-40K by aligning reviewer weaknesses with author responses and grounding the resulting feedback in localized paper evidence. We post-train Qwen3-8B-Base with multi-task supervised fine-tuning followed by GRPO using candidate-aware, weakness-specific rubric rewards. We also introduce ActReview-Bench, a human-curated benchmark of 1,000 instances for evaluating diagnostic quality and revision usefulness. Experiments show that ActReview outperforms prior specialized review-generation models on actionability and grounding while remaining competitive with strong prompt-based LLMs. Human evaluation confirms improved revision usefulness while revealing a remaining gap in technical accuracy, and additional analyses support generalization to held-out papers and robustness across independent judges.
2609.09076.paper_summary_zh: 隨著大型語言模型（LLMs）越來越多地用於提交前的自我審查，對於不僅能識別弱點而且能指導作者進行具體修訂的反饋需求也在增長。我們將此研究為可行的同行評審生成，並將其分解為兩個子任務：診斷性主張生成和修訂建議生成。我們介紹了 ActReview，一個以反駁為指導的後訓練框架，將特定於論文的診斷與具體的、有根據的修訂計劃相連接。我們的核心見解是，作者的反駁揭示了應對審稿人關注的可行行動，因此可以為以修訂為導向的反饋提供潛在的監督。從 OpenReview 上的真實審稿-反駁線索中，我們通過將審稿人的弱點與作者的回應對齊，並將結果反饋基於局部的論文證據，構建了 ActReview-40K。我們使用多任務監督微調隨後進行 GRPO，對 Qwen3-8B-Base 進行後訓練，使用候選人感知的、特定於弱點的評分標準獎勵。我們還介紹了 ActReview-Bench，一個人為策劃的基準，包含 1,000 個實例，用於評估診斷質量和修訂有用性。實驗表明，ActReview 在可行性和基礎性方面超越了先前專門的評審生成模型，同時與強大的基於提示的 LLMs 競爭。人類評估確認了修訂有用性的改善，同時揭示了技術準確性方面仍存在的差距，額外的分析支持對保留論文的泛化和在獨立評審者之間的穩健性。
